title: CyTOF protocol for immune monitoring of solid tumors from mouse models
protocol: Dissociate tumors into single cells.
Wash dissociated tumor cells through a series of washes.
Add EDTA during initial steps after plating to avoid clumping of the cells.
Pipette at least 1.5 million cells from each individual sample onto each well of a U-bottom 96-microwell plate.
Centrifuge plate at 500 g for 5 min at 25°C, decant supernatant.
Repeat washing process for minimum/average 2 washes after the first plating.
Wash cells with 200 μL of 2 mM EDTA per well.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min at 25°C.
Decant the supernatant.
Wash cells with 250 μL of Maxpar® PBS per well.
Resuspend cells in 50 μL/well of 20 μM Pt (1:500) in Maxpar® PBS.
Incubate the plate for 2.5 min at 25°C.
Quench excess reagent by adding 150 μL/well complete RPMI directly to each well.
Centrifuge the plate at 500 g for 5 min at 25°C.
Decant the supernatant.
Wash cells in 200 μL of Maxpar® CSB per well.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min at 25°C.
Decant the supernatant.
Repeat the wash step two more times using Maxpar® CSB.
Carefully pipette off residual supernatant from each well without disturbing cell pellets.
Add barcode stain 75 μL/well to cells.
Gently resuspend to mix.
Incubate the plate for 25 min at 25°C.
Add 150 μL/well of Maxpar® CSB to the samples.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min at 25°C.
Decant the supernatant.
Resuspend with 200 μL/well of Maxpar® CSB to wash.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min at 25°C.
Decant the supernatant.
Repeat the wash step.
Combine well contents into multiplex tubes (VWR® Culture Tubes – Polypropylene, 4.5 mL).
Use 300 μL Maxpar® CSB to mix and pipette transfer from one well to the next for batched samples.
Pipette well mixture into multiplex tubes through a 40 μm filter cap.
Repeat this process at least two more times for a total of 900 μL for transferring each tube.
Centrifuge the multiplexed tubes at 500 g for 5 min.
Decant the supernatant.
Pipette off any residual volume carefully to avoid dilution.
Resuspend cells in calculated volume of Fc block stain.
Incubate tubes for 10 min at 25°C.
Add in the calculated volume of Surface Stain Cocktail.
Incubate tubes for 30 min at 25°C.
Add 1 mL of Maxpar® CSB/tube.
Centrifuge tubes at 500 g for 5 min at 25°C.
Decant the supernatant.
Wash samples in 1 mL of Maxpar® CSB.
Centrifuge tubes at 500 g for 5 min at 25°C.
Decant the supernatant off.
Pipette off residual volume.
Resuspend cells in 300 μL/tube of eBio™ Fix/Perm.
Incubate for 30 min at 25°C.
Add to samples 1 mL of perm buffer/tube.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min at 25°C.
Decant the supernatant.
Wash samples with 1 mL of perm buffer/tube.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min at 25°C.
Decant the supernatant and pipette residual volume off.
Resuspend cells in calculated volume of intracellular stain.
Incubate for 30 min at 25°C.
Add to samples 1 mL of perm buffer/tube.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min at 25°C.
Decant the supernatant.
Wash samples in 1 mL of Maxpar® CSB/tube.
Centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min at 25°C.
Decant the supernatant off.
Pipette any residual volume off.
Resuspend cells in 400 μL/tube of 1.6% PFA in Maxpar® PBS.
Fix the cells for 10 min at 25°C if proceeding immediately to ‘CyTOF for Tumors – Rh Staining + Cell Counting’.
Centrifuge tubes at 700 g for 5 min at 25°C.
Decant the supernatant and pipette off residual volume.
Resuspend cells in 300 μL/tube of Rh.
Incubate the resuspended cells for 30 min to 1 h at 25°C.
Add 1 mL of Maxpar® CSB to each tube.
Perform a final cell count after resuspending in Maxpar® CSB.
Centrifuge tubes at 700 g for 5 minutes at 25°C.
Decant supernatant.
Repeat wash.
After decanting, vortex tubes for 2–3 seconds to resuspend cells in residual volume.
Store tubes at 4°C until data acquisition.
Mix additional EDTA into the blood collection tube after collection.
Shake the tube vigorously to mix blood well with anticoagulant.
Pipette 90 μL blood from the collection tube into a deep-well 96-well plate.
Add 10 μL of 0.5 M EDTA to the well and mix well.
Proceed immediately to Fc receptor block step.
Pipette 2 μL of stock Fc receptor block directly into wells.
Mix well.
Incubate for 10 min at 25°C.
Add 48 μL surface stain solution into the wells.
Mix well.
Incubate for 30 min at 25°C.
Add 1 mL of Maxpar® CSB to samples.
Centrifuge plate at 500 g for 5 min at 25°C.
Decant the supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 100 μL of Maxpar® CSB.
Pipette 2 mL of pre-warmed 1× BD Phosflow™ Fix/Lyse into each well.
Incubate plate in a 37°C water bath for 15 min.
Centrifuge plate at 500 g for 5 min at 25°C.
Decant the supernatant.
Ensure red blood cells have fully lysed before proceeding.
Wash cells with 1 mL of Maxpar® CSB per well.
Centrifuge plate at 500 g for 5 min at 25°C.
Decant the supernatant.
Incubate in 400 μL/well of 1.6% PFA in Maxpar® PBS for 10 min at 4°C (optional).
Store samples at 4°C for up to 20 h if intracellular staining is skipped (optional).
Resuspend cells in 300 μL/well of eBio™ Fix/Perm.
Incubate for 30 min at 25°C.
Add 1 mL of perm buffer per well.
Centrifuge plate at 500 g for 5 min at 25°C.
Decant the supernatant.
Wash samples with 1 mL of perm buffer per well.
Centrifuge plate at 500 g for 5 min at 25°C.
Decant the supernatant and pipette off residual volume.
Resuspend cells in calculated volume of intracellular stain.
Incubate for 30 min at 25°C.
Add 1 mL of perm buffer per well and centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min at 25°C.
Decant supernatant.
Wash samples with 1 mL of Maxpar® CSB per well, then centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min at 25°C.
Decant supernatant and pipette any residual volume off.
Resuspend cells in 400 μL per well of 1.6% PFA in Maxpar® PBS and fix for 10 min at 25°C if proceeding immediately to ‘CyTOF for Whole Blood – Barcode Stain and Batching’.
Optional: Store samples in 1.6% PFA in Maxpar® PBS up to one week at 4°C.
Centrifuge samples at 700 g for 5 min at 25°C, decant supernatant carefully.
Vortex gently.
Resuspend each well in 250 μL of 1× Barcode Perm Buffer.
Thaw the stock tubes containing desired barcodes from the 20-Plex Pd Barcoding Kit and spin in a minicentrifuge for 10 s.
Directly add 7 μL of the thawed barcode into each well and incubate samples for 30 min at 25°C.
Centrifuge samples at 700 g for 5 min at 25°C, decant supernatant carefully.
Wash with 2 mL of Maxpar® CSB per well.
Centrifuge plate at 700 g for 5 minutes at 25°C.
Decant supernatant carefully.
Repeat wash.
Combine well contents into multiplex tubes using 300 μL Maxpar® CSB to mix and transfer from one well to the next.
Pipette well mixture into multiplex tubes through a 40 μm filter cap.
Centrifuge tubes at 700 g for 5 minutes at 25°C.
Decant supernatant.
Resuspend cells in 300 μL/tube of working Cell-ID™ Ir solution (1:3000 in Maxpar® Fix/Perm solution).
Incubate for 30 minutes.
Add 1 mL of Maxpar® CSB per tube.
Perform a final cell count using trypan blue.
Centrifuge tubes at 700 g for 5 minutes at 25°C.
Decant the supernatant.
Wash using 1 mL of Maxpar® CSB per tube.
After decanting, vortex tubes for 2–3 seconds to resuspend cells in the residual volume.
Store tubes at 4°C until data acquisition.
